title: appointments.availability.check
description: The slot to ask about, and nothing else (appointments#122): the opening hours, the agenda and the settings are read from the hub by the runtime (`reads`), never sent by the caller — hours a caller supplies are hours a caller can forge.

start_datetime.description: When the slot starts, ISO 8601 with its offset (`2026-08-03T09:00:00+02:00`). The hours are judged on the business's own clock, so an instant without an offset is read as UTC.

duration_minutes.description: How long the slot lasts. Absent = the hub's `default_duration`. The appointment has to fit WHOLE inside an open stretch, so this is what decides whether a booking that starts before closing runs past it.

staff_id.description: Ask about ONE professional's agenda. Absent = the whole agenda: any appointment or block of the hub counts.

exclude_hold_ref.description: The pending booking request that OWNS a hold on this slot, so its own hold does not refuse it. Only the request that set the slot aside can name it.
